summary: International Media Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K solely to report depositing $2,000 into its trust account to extend the deadline to complete an initial business combination by one month, from July 2, 2026 to August 2, 2026. This is the 19th of 24 such monthly extensions. The filing does not announce a business combination, a definitive agreement, or any other special situation. It is a routine extension notice by a SPAC, which does not constitute a special situation as defined for this analysis.
